meta.parties: Katiritamby Et Al v. Parupathipillai Et Al

rules.statement: An erroneous decision on a pure question of law does not prevent the court from deciding the same question arising between the same parties in a subsequent suit according to law.
rules.supporting_quote: "A decision which is erroneous cannot have the force of res adjudicata in a subsequent proceeding for a different relief. Or when the cause of action is different, but the matter has already been in controversy, then the estoppel ought to be limited to matters distinctly put in issue and determined previously, and should further be restricted to questions of fact or of mixed law and fact .... section 537 .... But as regards the law, an erroneous decision does not prevent the Court from deciding the same question arising between the same parties in a subsequent suit according to law."
